g.text: L14B / Three explorers sharing finite resources
Woodland: 8 patches x 12 units. 30 periods. Same terrain and seed; A/C profiles swapped.
Agent / profile / units / harvested patches / variation requests
Agent / profile / units / harvested patches / variation requests
Rings mark exploration requests after confirmed M_B predictions. Paths show all measured body moves.
Patch labels, exact map and remaining stock belong only to this experimenter view.
Shared depletion changes each history. These two runs alone do not estimate a pure profile effect.
No hunger, physical collisions, communication, group survival or general boredom model in this fixture.
